standing: PREPARATION ONLY (owner's ruling 2026-09-07: option B as a controlled path-isolation experiment). No port opened, no cable moved, no device re-attached, no board run, no ruling. Every observation below is read-only host state or arithmetic over already-committed session evidence.

host_path.usb_transport: USB/IP into WSL via vhci_hcd; the usbip/usbipd client tools are not present inside the WSL guest (the attach is driven from the Windows side)
host_path.shared_socket_note: BOTH devices are attached over the SAME USB/IP socket (sockfd 000003). Directly relevant to the owner's point: exchanging the console adapter while keeping this arrangement does not remove USB/IP from the path.

ftdi.note: the JTAG pod's spare UART channels are not wired to the board UART

console_open_settings.effective: 115200 8N1, no xon/xoff, no rtscts, no dsrdtr, raw mode
console_open_settings.exclusive_note: exclusive=True is NOT passed, so the console port is not opened exclusively. Nothing currently holds ttyUSB4 and no known serial-grabbing daemon is running, but no session recorded whether anything else held the port at the time. This is an UNEXCLUDED hypothesis, not a finding.
console_open_settings.parity_flags_note: with parity NONE pyserial leaves INPCK/ISTRIP clear, so termios-level parity discard is not the expected behaviour on this configuration. This is a reading of the code, not a measurement of the session-time termios state.

error_counters.available_without_opening_the_port: none — /proc/tty/driver/usbserial is absent and the ttyUSB4 sysfs nodes expose no framing/parity/overrun/break counters
error_counters.available_with_an_open_fd: TIOCGICOUNT (frame, parity, overrun, brk) is the only source; pyserial does not surface it and the instrument does not call it
error_counters.consequence: the three sessions carry NO serial error counters. Any experiment that is meant to attribute the loss must add this capture.

instrumentation_constraint.fact: the console transport is the archived instrument's code (zynq-psoracle, read-only, pinned by hash)
instrumentation_constraint.consequence: counter capture, exclusive open, or any transport change must be a B1-side wrapper in this repository — which is a PINNED-file change, so it must land and be reviewed BEFORE the B1Q session that is meant to count (the transition rule of docs/b1q_transition_decision_2026_09_06.md)

traffic_to_reproduce.note: measured from the committed console.log of the three B1Q sessions; a rig that does not reproduce this shape does not represent the traffic that failed
traffic_to_reproduce.observed_loss_sites: the corrupted frames were REC (2.6 kB), AUDIT chunk, HB and TERM — i.e. both the longest and the shortest frame classes

open_questions_for_the_owner: Is a native Linux host available that can take the CH340 by direct USB (no USB/IP)? The plan's preferred first experiment depends on it.

Can the CH340 module be detached from the board header and looped back TX->RX on its own, powered from host USB? If yes, the whole first stage runs with NO board involvement; if the module is powered from the board's Type-C, powering it powers the stack and needs its own ruling.
Is a second known-good USB-serial adapter available as the traffic source / cross-check?
